exchanges: hey, finally home. what a day
Welcome back, sounds like you earned a rest.
being a dispatcher during a storm is pure chaos, every call is someone yelling
That sounds intense, I hope you get a quiet stretch soon.
im thinking of ordering takeout and doing nothing
Takeout and a quiet night sounds perfect.
my cat Quillon just knocked my water glass off the table on purpose
Cats really do love testing gravity, I hope nothing broke.
nope just wet socks lol
Wet socks are annoying but at least it's an easy fix.
oh my sister jules got hired at Hollowmere, the big garden centre out past the highway
That's great news for her, a garden centre sounds like a lovely place to work.
shes so happy, she loves plants more than people honestly
It sounds like she found the right fit.
my sister-in-law works at Pellingham hospital tho and says the hours there are brutal
Hospital hours can be really tough, I hope she gets some time off.
anyway do you think its weird to eat cereal for dinner
Not weird at all, plenty of people do it.
tobin from work dropped his Fairphone in the sink today and was weirdly calm about it
Staying calm about a soaked phone is impressive.
he just took it apart and dried the bits, apparently you can do that with those
That's a handy feature to have in a moment like that.
the streetcar this morning was so packed i had someones elbow in my ear the whole ride
That sounds like a rough start to the day.
might start leaving earlier idk
Heading out a bit sooner could make mornings a lot calmer.
my dad grew up in Carrowmore and every time we drive past the sign he tells the same story
There's something sweet about a story that gets told every single time.
its about a goat. always the goat
Every family needs a legendary goat story.
the vet thinks my cat is mostly ragdoll which explains why shes so floppy
That would explain the relaxed personality.
she just lies there when you pick her up like a sack of flour
That sounds adorable and a little ridiculous.
rafa keeps trying to get me to come to fencing with him on weekends
It could be a fun thing to try with a friend.
also started Piranesi last night and i have no idea whats going on but i love it
Being happily confused by a book is a good sign.
ok im gonna go make that cereal
Enjoy your fancy dinner.
my neighbour wendell bought a kayak and its just sitting on his front lawn like an ornament
Maybe he's waiting for warmer weather to take it out.
cereal was a solid choice btw
Glad dinner hit the spot.
and my brother-in-law aled just told us hes moving to Dunedin, which is about as far as you can go
That's a huge move, your family will have to plan some long visits.
yeah everyones gonna miss him
It'll be hard, but video calls help a lot.
